questionResolved: Does requested bulk Create All count establish actual completed milling casts?
answer: NO. First-person reports describe premature bulk milling interruption after a successful craft despite inventory remaining. Requested operations, gross herbs available and completed casts must be recorded separately.

sources.author: Pandeath-baelgun
sources.claim: Bulk milling Mycobloom sometimes succeeds once and then fails with Requires 10 Mycobloom although player reports having enough herbs; reports single-craft workaround.

sources.author: Feaver
sources.claim: Create All sometimes completes one Mycobloom milling craft then stops with Requires 10 Mycobloom despite large remaining herb inventory; another poster proposes first-stack selection as cause.

sourceAncestry.relatedSecondaryComment: DragonKnight first-stack workaround is a comment under the Feaver report, not an independent measured cause

evidenceLimitations: Historical 2024 behavior only; no proof of current 2026 Retail bug
No output histogram, rank-specific results, actual successful-cast denominator or measured E
First-stack hypothesis is community troubleshooting, not a verified game mechanism
Failed/aborted attempts are not zero-output completed casts
Do not infer any numeric dropChance or expectedQuantity from forum reports

denominatorGuard.rule: Count a cast only after confirmed successful completion; do not count requested Create All iterations or errors as completed zero-output casts.
